_README: Temporal + territorial metadata for every Act in the graph.
This file is the SINGLE source of truth for two questions the engine could
not previously answer:
1. Is this Act actually in force today?  (temporal)
2. Where does this Act apply?            (territorial)
REPEAL RULE (important, and deliberately conservative):
An Act is marked 'repealed' ONLY when the repealing Act is itself present
in this corpus AND the repeal is stated in retrieved statutory text. The
authority is recorded in 'repeal_authority' and must be a real section_id
in the graph. We never mark an Act repealed on the strength of outside
knowledge alone, because the engine would then suppress law it cannot
replace with anything it can actually cite.
Consequence worth knowing: the Industrial Disputes Act 1947 and the Payment
of Gratuity Act 1972 are, in the wider world, subsumed by the Industrial
Relations Code 2020 and the Social Security Code 2020 respectively. Neither
Code is in this corpus, so neither repeal is represented here and both Acts
remain 'in_force' for retrieval purposes. Ingest those Codes and add the
repeal here, and the engine will switch over with no code change.
TO CORRECT THE COMMENCEMENT POSITION: change 'status' and 'in_force_from'
below and re-run  python -m ingest.act_metadata_loader.  Nothing else needs
to change; retrieval reads these values from the graph at query time.

acts.note: Section 69 repeals the Payment of Wages Act 1936, Minimum Wages Act 1948, Payment of Bonus Act 1965 and Equal Remuneration Act 1976. Section 1(3) commences the Code by Government notification, with different dates permitted for different provisions.

Act No. 35 of 2020. Section 104(1) repeals the Trade Unions Act 1926, the Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Act 1946 and the Industrial Disputes Act 1947. Commencement confirmed by the footnote in the official text: '21st day of November, 2025 — vide Notification No. S.O. 5320(E), dated 21st November, 2025, Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, sec. 3(ii).' Section 104(1) was itself substituted by Act 1 of 2026, s.2, w.e.f. 21-11-2025 — that amending Act is what is sometimes loosely called 'the 2026 labour code'; it is not a separate Code and the ingested PDF ('As on 2nd April 2026') already incorporates it.

Act No. 36 of 2020. Section 164(1) repeals nine enactments, including the Payment of Gratuity Act 1972 (item 6), the Employees' Provident Funds Act 1952, the Employees' State Insurance Act 1948 and the Maternity Benefit Act 1961. The official text is stamped 'As on the 21th November, 2025', the commencement date. Because this single Code absorbs gratuity, PF, ESI and maternity benefit, ingesting it closes several coverage gaps at once (EPF and maternity queries were previously answered 'not covered').

Repealed by section 104(1)(c) of the Industrial Relations Code, 2020, w.e.f. 21 November 2025. Suppressed from retrieval and never citable. Termination, retrenchment, lay-off, closure, strike and industrial-dispute questions are answered from IRC 2020 instead (s.70 replaces s.25F, s.71 replaces s.25G, s.66 replaces s.25B, s.62-63 replace s.22-24, and so on).

Repealed by section 164(1) item 6 of the Code on Social Security, 2020, w.e.f. 21 November 2025. Suppressed from retrieval and never citable. Gratuity questions are answered from SSC 2020 instead (s.53 replaces s.4, s.56 replaces s.7, s.54 replaces s.2A, s.55 replaces s.6).

acts.act_name: Karnataka Shops and Commercial Establishments Act, 1961
acts.note: STATE legislation. Section 1(2) extends it to the State of Karnataka only. It must never be cited to a user in another state — see jurisdiction filtering in agents/nodes/retrieval_node.py.

Expressly repealed by section 69(1) of the Code on Wages, 2019. Suppressed from retrieval and never citable while COW_2019 is marked in_force. Minimum wage, overtime and wage-payment questions are answered from the Code on Wages instead.
